notes: TASK_862 canonical battery for the D17 sequence: the four DEC-2 regime windows (each against its own runs/831_ext per-window floor artifact), the full OOS window (LEDGER 832/E5-oos-real), and the two pre-registered walk-forward quarters (runs/858_oos/WALKFORWARD_PREREG.md). Operator is fixed by scorecard.py to the 848 read of record. SCHEDULED planner run against the read-only source of record - never inside the factory loop. Per D17 a consistency pass confers NO gate status. PANEL FRAME SOURCE = minute (D30 rider (c), TASK_865): the pinned frame is read from the minute ohlcv table at a 1440-minute stride - the 861 leg-1/2/3 configuration - so leg 4 grades on the SAME price table and the SAME breadth (62/64 frame slots) as the bar it is compared against, instead of silently reading ohlcv_daily (33/64) and confounding source (D20) and breadth with the effect under test. Measured read-only 2026-07-30 (file:trading_data.db?mode=ro): the minute table covers this manifest's whole span - MAX ts 1775001540 = 2026-03-31T23:59 UTC, i.e. at or past every window end. Row count inside oos_full 2025-10-05..2026-03-31 = 8,047,476 AT EVAL_VECTOR'S OWN BOUNDARY (re-measured read-only 2026-08-03; TASK_869: _to_epoch is now UTC-midnight strptime - was LOCAL-timezone, 8,047,459 - so timestamp >= UTC midnight of the start date AND <= UTC midnight of the END date; the final day's intraday rows are OUTSIDE the window by construction, on every source, and the window no longer depends on the machine's timezone). Counting the whole final day instead gives 8,091,394 (UTC day); the extra ~43.9k rows are that boundary, NOT missing coverage. Adding close IS NOT NULL AND close != 0, or restricting to the 64 frame slots, changes none of these counts. Flipping this to "daily" is a one-word change - and as of the fix pass it is REFUSED before any grading: the D30 rider (b) breadth floor now applies to the DAILY pin too, and the daily table covers 33 of 64 frame slots (0.52) against the pinned floor of 0.9. Running it daily therefore takes an explicit require_active_slots override, and is graded WITHIN-panel only per D20.
